notes: The 4.73.0 staged commit pushed NEW overlays as skeletons and rebuilt — but the fetch lived in addOverlay, which staging bypasses, so a newly staged series committed with zero points and hung on the loading watermark forever. OK now fetches every point-less overlay (chaining the fan fetch where staged), then saves, rebuilds once, and surfaces per-series errors as toasts. Found by the owner running it live — the discipline the repo exists to encode, again.
